ratings.notes: Comprehensive, well-structured 2-hop paths with specific gene symbols, PMIDs, and testable hypotheses. Minor concern: PMID specificity unverified but plausible.
Covers core paths (ACE2/IL6→F3/SERPINE1) correctly but lacks depth, misses NETs/F12, no PMIDs cited, and conflates ACE2 as both hop-1 and entry receptor.
Nearly identical quality to Q015-A; well-organized, cites same PMIDs, covers all three major paths. Slightly less structured summary table but equally rigorous.

result.pairwise_reason: Q015-A and Q015-C are near-equivalent in quality; Q015-A edges out with a cleaner summary table and explicit testable hypotheses section, making it marginally more actionable for research use.
